relationships.evidence_quote: A good binding activity was found between hispidulin and PTGS2 (score =  - 8.9 kcal/mol).

relationships.subject: hispidulin
relationships.evidence_quote: The levels of PTGS2 and NLRP3 inflammasome were decreased with the hispidulin dose increase in the IL-1β-treated cells (p < 0.05).

relationships.subject: hispidulin
relationships.evidence_quote: In the CYP-treated rats, hispidulin treatment improved the bladder pain through decreasing the nociceptive score (p < 0.01)

key_findings: Hispidulin binds PTGS2 and suppresses PTGS2 and NLRP3 inflammasome in IL-1β-treated urothelial cells and CYP-treated rat bladder.
Hispidulin reduced bladder pain and inflammation in cyclophosphamide cystitis, similar to ibuprofen.
